summary.text: Cherrish Pryor is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 94 who has represented the district since 2008 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She holds degrees from Indiana University-Bloomington and IUPUI.

paragraphs.text: Pryor earned a B.S. in criminal justice from Indiana University-Bloomington and an M.S. in public affairs from Indiana University-Purdue University Indianapolis.
She took office in the Indiana House in 2008.
